faq.title: Travel Insurance FAQs
faq.q1: When should I activate my travel protection?
faq.a1: You can purchase coverage before your departure or set it to activate automatically the moment your flight takes off.
faq.q2: How do I submit an insurance claim?
faq.a2: Simply upload your receipts or medical reports in the Getly app. Our insurance partners process most claims within 48 hours.
